title: Clopen irreducible components of an etale scheme over a normal base
statement: Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth] whose local rings are integrally closed domains [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Let $q:Z\to X$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Then $Z$ is locally topologically Noetherian (every point of $Z$ has an open neighbourhood whose underlying topological space is Noetherian, i.e. satisfies the descending chain condition on closed subsets) and geometrically unibranch (for every $z\in Z$, a strict henselization [def-sc-ring-strict-henselization] of $\mathcal O_{Z,z}$ has irreducible spectrum), and every irreducible component [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $|Z|$ is open and closed in $|Z|$. Consequently every connected component of $|Z|$ (a maximal nonempty connected subset [def-weil-connected-scheme]) is irreducible and is open and closed in $|Z|$. The scheme $Z$ may be empty.

proof.text: Apply the proved source-library theorem Scheme.isDomain_and_isIntegrallyClosed_stalk_of_etale_of_isDomain to q and the given normal stalks. Its affine-local proof uses the identification of affine stalks with prime localizations and normality ascending along etale ring maps. Thus every stalk of Z is an integrally closed domain.

source.place: Tag 033C, label lemma-normal-goes-up, etale specialization; schemes.tex Tag 01HV

proof.text: Fix a stalk A and a presentation with K,H in Type (max u v). The private equivalence liftBase identifies A-algebras in that universe with algebras over R = ULift A. Etaleness is preserved because A to R is an algebra isomorphism; pointedLift restricts the induced equivalence of over categories to pointed etale algebras. Transport the residue separable-closure structure along the residue-field equivalence and transport the specified colimit cocone, obtaining IsStrictHenselization R K H. The existing strict-henselization locality and pointed-etale small-filtered theorems now apply in their single common universe. Restrict the colimit to a small model of its index, transport locality to its chosen colimit, and apply the normal etale colimit theorem. R is a normal domain and its prime localizations are normal by localization of integrally closed domains. Transport the resulting domain along the specified colimit isomorphism to H. PrimeSpectrum.irreducibleSpace gives the required irreducibility.

source.place: Tag 06DI, label lemma-henselization-normal; algebra.tex Tags 04GP and 04GW; properties.tex Tag 0BQ3, label lemma-normal-geometrically-unibranch

proof.text: A locally Noetherian scheme is locally connected (the proved source-library instance IsLocallyNoetherian.locallyConnectedSpace). Hence each connected component is clopen. Give it the corresponding open subscheme structure, and transport domain stalks along its open inclusion. The proved source-library theorem irreducibleSpace_of_isDomain_stalk then shows that this connected locally Noetherian open subscheme is irreducible. Mapping its whole space into Z shows that the connected component is irreducible as a subset.

source.place: Tag 0357, label lemma-normal-locally-finite-nr-irreducibles, affine-open argument; Tag 033M, label lemma-normal-Noetherian

proof.text: For an irreducible component C choose z in C. Irreducibility implies preconnectedness; since connectedComponent z is clopen and meets C, IsPreconnected.subset_isClopen gives C contained in it. Its irreducibility and maximality of C give equality, proving C clopen. For any maximal nonempty connected subset C the same containment and maximality identify it with connectedComponent z, proving both irreducibility and clopenness. Empty sources have no such components, so the argument is vacuous there.
